purpose: Correct v1 zero-decision reset metadata check and compare iid 3D independent pedals with iid 2D exclusive longitudinal actions before training
randomness: At each decision draw three iid uniform [-1,1] values from the identical per-cell/repeat stream: steer=d0, 3D gas=(d1+1)/2 brake=(d2+1)/2, 2D gas=max(d1,0) brake=max(-d1,0). Steering draws are matched but diverging trajectories are not transition-matched.
state_diversity: Diagnostic-only simulator telemetry: unique 10m xy occupancy bins, and unique (10m xy, 8 heading sectors, 5m/s speed sectors) bins; also report occupied xy bins per 100 decisions. No privileged telemetry is given to either action policy or learner.
selection: Compare 8 paired road/repeat episodes. Prefer larger mean final progress when difference >=0.01 unless its mean damage is more than 0.1 higher. Otherwise prefer larger mean raw return when difference >=1. Otherwise prefer more mean unique spatial bins, then lower mean damage; a remaining tie favors 2D exclusivity. Report reward, lengths, finishes, occupancy and per-road differences regardless; selection is an engineering decision on reused TRAIN, not generalization.
excluded: No confirmation, blind, official, or fresh development geometry resets. No learner update during comparison.
